CARRIED FOR THE HUMAN, not a defect and not blocking. One-message-per-turn binds among SIDECAR-authored messages only. On a first turn the inbound event is still forwarded to the Rust core before the presentation is emitted, so the contact receives the presentation AND the core's normal reply. Unlike baja and cortacircuitos, whose claims flip EnvioPermitido/SalidaPermitida and thereby suppress the core's reply at the outbox seam, the presentation claim suppresses nothing. This is 01-blueprint.yaml's explicit reading of AC-3 and matches AC-3's own parenthetical 'never two sidecar-authored sends in one turn', so it is a documented design decision; flagged because 00-spec.yaml's invariant reads more absolutely ('At most one outbound message is emitted per conversational turn'). If the human wants the stricter reading, it is a follow-up task, not a defect in this diff.
